base_branch_rationale: Wave C branches from wave B so the batch stays one line of work in one repository.

owner_start_signal.detail: The owner set the goal to implement the whole cluster plan in batch order; this record bounds Batch 3 wave A.

implementation_scope.summary: Localized values as rows in their own immutable table keyed by schema, record, revision, locale and field; a fallback chain that marks every returned value exact or fallback and names the locale it came from; a coverage report that counts rather than parses; and the optional localized field-descriptor key, which is the only change this batch permits to the workbench.

forbidden_files_note: OperationDescriptor and SyncOperationRuntime are forbidden on purpose: the freeze enforces the v2 policy at registration precisely so that neither has to change.
forbidden_behavior: changing the existing schema, record or version tables in any way
changing the workbench beyond adding localized as an optional ninth field-descriptor key
updating or deleting a localized value row: a row belongs to its revision and is written once
storing a value for a field the schema does not declare localized
treating an absent value as an empty one: absent and empty are different answers
adding a public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
changing larena/core, larena/access or any package other than larena/storage
touching larena.test or any live environment
push, release or deployment without a separate owner request
test_plan: Plain-PHP package tests in the existing storage style with an in-memory SQLite capsule mirroring the frozen shapes.
required_tests: a value is written with its revision and read back for that locale
a second write for the same revision, locale and field is refused: a revision is immutable
a value for a field the schema does not declare localized is refused
reading a locale with no row walks the fallback chain and marks the value fallback, naming the locale it came from
a value present in the requested locale is marked exact
a field with no row in any locale of the chain is absent, and absent is distinguishable from empty
coverage reports present and missing fields per locale and whether the record is complete
a required localized field missing in a secondary locale is refused unless the schema allows partial locales
the workbench accepts a field descriptor with the optional localized key and still accepts one without it
smoke_plan: Migration parity on sqlite and mysql, a two-locale record written and read back in separate processes with exact and fallback markers, and the coverage report on both drivers.

action_gate_summary.note: Re-run the action gate inside the core package repository at coding start.

stop_conditions: a frozen table shape, identity grammar, state set or reason code would have to change
an existing schema, record or version table would have to change
the workbench would have to change
a recursive CTE or a MySQL 8 only feature would be required
a file outside the allowed boundary would have to change
an unrecorded product or architecture decision is required
the storage package repository is dirty or not initialized
nonclaims: A launch record authorizes a bounded coding wave; it does not authorize push, release or deployment.
Wave C stores and reads locales. Publishing one locale while another stays a draft is wave D.
A localized value is content, not a secret: visibility stays a property of the field, in every locale.

amendments.reason: the path index is driver-specific because a 2048-character column cannot be indexed whole on MySQL with utf8mb4; the relation identity is rewritten on a move so the frozen grammar stays true of the row as it is
